hematology-h01.title: 造血、CBC、Ret与骨髓诊断语言
hematology-h01.first_pass_focus: 先建立三系血细胞生产—成熟—外周读数的共同语言，让后续血液病从定位而非病名开始。
hematology-h01.stop_line: 不展开具体贫血/白血病/免疫病；正常止血只Recall。
hematology-h01.recall_spine: RBC结构与物理行为 → 红系生产—成熟—清除闭环 → WBC数量 → 巨核—血小板身份与五动作 Recall → 血液作为流体内环境 → 五层证据与最终故障树

c-h01-lg01.label: RBC结构与物理行为
c-h01-lg01.goal: connect RBC construction and biconcave geometry to deformability, rouleaux/ESR and osmotic fragility without treating those three readouts as interchangeable.
c-h01-lg01.closure: given a change in cell shape, plasma composition or extracellular tonicity, predict which of deformability / ESR / osmotic fragility should change and state which object each readout is actually observing.
c-h01-lg01.continuity_rationale: KP02–03 form one physical model. H1-SC01 remains live: hereditary-spherocytosis ESR direction is not silently resolved.

c-h01-lg02.label: 红系生产—成熟—清除闭环
c-h01-lg02.goal: reconstruct low-O2 → HIF/EPO → erythroid maturation/Ret → mature RBC lifetime → extravascular/intravascular clearance as one production–turnover loop.
c-h01-lg02.closure: from anemia/low oxygen plus Ret and destruction clues, explain whether the marrow is being stimulated, whether delivery is occurring, and where normal/abnormal turnover evidence would appear.
c-h01-lg02.continuity_rationale: EPO, Ret and RBC clearance answer one lifecycle question and should be learned as one chain rather than three fact islands.

c-h01-lg03.label: WBC数量：池子移动还是实际生产变化
c-h01-lg03.goal: distinguish circulation-pool redistribution from marrow production and preserve only the minimum monocyte/macrophage and T/B identity needed by later C Blocks.
c-h01-lg03.closure: when peripheral neutrophils or leukocyte proportions change, state why a count change does not automatically prove immediate marrow overproduction and name the later owner when immune detail is required.
c-h01-lg03.continuity_rationale: this is a genuine standalone learner problem; merging it with platelet biology would create a mixed-task group merely to avoid a singleton.

c-h01-lg04.label: 巨核—血小板身份与五动作 Recall
c-h01-lg04.goal: connect megakaryocyte origin to platelet identity and recall adhesion–aggregation–release–contraction–procoagulant-surface actions without reopening normal hemostasis as a second Primary.
c-h01-lg04.closure: from endothelial injury, reconstruct the platelet action sequence and correctly route full coagulation/anticoagulation/fibrinolysis back to A1 rather than expanding H1.
c-h01-lg04.continuity_rationale: KP08 gives the product identity and KP09 gives what that product does; they are inseparable for later ITP/bleeding reasoning.

c-h01-lg05.label: 血液作为流体内环境
c-h01-lg05.goal: distinguish Hct/viscosity, crystalloid vs colloid osmotic pressure and pH as different properties of blood, while routing full hemodynamics/water-acid-base models to their owning Systems.
c-h01-lg05.closure: given a change in Hct, plasma protein, electrolyte or ventilation/renal handling, identify which blood variable is directly affected and what must be reopened outside H1 for the complete mechanism.
c-h01-lg05.continuity_rationale: these are the blood-environment properties remaining after cell-specific biology; they share a “what physical property is this measuring?” discrimination task.

c-h01-lg06.label: 五层证据与最终故障树
c-h01-lg06.goal: integrate lineage identity with CBC → Ret → smear → marrow aspirate → biopsy and route single-/multi-lineage abnormalities to production, maturation, loss/destruction, distribution, clone or structural marrow failure.
c-h01-lg06.closure: from an unfamiliar CBC/Ret/smear pattern, choose the next evidence layer, explain what it can add that the prior layer cannot, and route the case to H3/H4/H5/H6/H7–H11 without prematurely naming a disease.
c-h01-lg06.continuity_rationale: KP01 is a useful Block-entry orientation but its *retrieval* becomes meaningful only after the physical/cellular substrate exists; KP12–13 complete the same diagnostic question.

hematology-h02.title: 血型、交叉配血与成分输血
hematology-h02.first_pass_focus: 把抗原/抗体方向、交叉配血、成分选择和输血反应放进同一输入风险模型。
hematology-h02.stop_line: 不展开完整移植免疫或外部输血指南。
hematology-h02.recall_spine: ABO身份 → Rh致敏 → 输什么、输多少、怎样判相容 → 输血反应第一分流 → 大量输血的成分性负担 → 自体输血的来源与安全边界

c-h02-lg01.label: ABO身份：抗原、抗体、H/A1/A2与遗传
c-h02-lg01.goal: build the ABO object model from RBC antigen vs plasma antibody, H precursor, A1/A2 precision, IgM/IgG identity and inheritance.
c-h02-lg01.closure: given donor/recipient ABO phenotype or a variant clue, state which antigen/antibody direction creates risk and avoid using “O万能” or one table cell without checking the actual component/direction.
c-h02-lg01.continuity_rationale: these five KPs answer “what is carried on the cell, what is in plasma, and why?” before transfusion decisions begin.

c-h02-lg02.label: Rh致敏：第一次暴露与后续风险
c-h02-lg02.goal: distinguish Rh/D from naturally occurring ABO antibodies and preserve the sensitization/time sequence.
c-h02-lg02.closure: explain why a first D exposure and a later exposure have different risk, including the maternal–fetal interface, while keeping H2-SC01 explicit rather than inventing a rule that Rh-negative donors inherently carry anti-D.
c-h02-lg02.continuity_rationale: Rh sensitization is a separate time-dependent mechanism; forcing it into ABO or product-choice groups would blur the key difference.

c-h02-lg03.label: 输什么、输多少、怎样判相容
c-h02-lg03.goal: choose the minimum necessary blood component and amount, then apply crossmatch direction and Source-specific loss thresholds.
c-h02-lg03.closure: from anemia/hemorrhage/coagulation-factor deficiency and a donor–recipient pairing, first identify the missing function, then choose component/amount and state why major crossmatch compatibility outranks “universal donor/recipient” labels.
c-h02-lg03.continuity_rationale: transfusion principles, crossmatch, blood-loss scale and component selection are one decision workflow. H2-SC02/H2-SC03 remain explicit boundaries.

c-h02-lg04.label: 输血反应第一分流
c-h02-lg04.goal: distinguish febrile, hemolytic, allergic, volume-overload and GVHD directions from timing/sign patterns, then connect the reaction to its target/attacker.
c-h02-lg04.closure: given a post-transfusion symptom cluster, identify the leading reaction, name the key evidence that separates it from close alternatives, and state the immediate Source-bounded response direction without turning the Block into a bedside transfusion guideline.
c-h02-lg04.continuity_rationale: KP11 is the comparison map; KP12–13 supply the major branches.

c-h02-lg05.label: 大量输血的成分性负担
c-h02-lg05.goal: tie citrate, stored-RBC potassium, temperature and dilution/consumption to alkalosis, hyperkalemia, hypocalcemia, hypothermia and coagulopathy.
c-h02-lg05.closure: from a massive-transfusion complication, trace it back to the responsible blood-product property and route full electrolyte/acid-base treatment back to A3.
c-h02-lg05.continuity_rationale: this is one dense mechanism cluster and should not be diluted by unrelated autologous-transfusion rules.

c-h02-lg06.label: 自体输血的来源与安全边界
c-h02-lg06.goal: distinguish salvage, hemodilution and predonation by where the blood comes from and when contamination makes salvage unsafe.
c-h02-lg06.closure: given a surgical/trauma scenario, identify whether an autologous route is Source-supported and which contamination/time boundary rules it out.
c-h02-lg06.continuity_rationale: self-donation is a separate source-selection problem; a singleton LG is justified rather than making a mixed “miscellaneous transfusion” group.

hematology-h03.title: 贫血总坐标、缺铁与巨幼细胞性贫血
hematology-h03.first_pass_focus: 用 Hb→MCV→Ret 建贫血坐标，再以铁/B12/叶酸证据区分生产与成熟问题。
hematology-h03.stop_line: 不展开H4/H5完整疾病，也不重复B的铁/B12/一碳代谢Primary。
hematology-h03.recall_spine: 贫血起手式 → IDA → 小细胞贫血 → 巨幼 → 范围/形态线索与最终贫血算法

c-h03-lg01.label: 贫血起手式：Hb → MCV → Ret
c-h03-lg01.goal: separate “is there anemia / how severe?” from “what size are cells?” and “is marrow response appropriate?”, then place common hypoxic compensation after localization.
c-h03-lg01.closure: from Hb/MCV/Ret and a short clinical context, route the case to production/maturation vs loss/destruction and select the next evidence family without equating MCV with diagnosis.
c-h03-lg01.continuity_rationale: KP01–06 together create the coordinate system. Splitting MCV and Ret into separate groups would destroy the actual diagnostic task.

c-h03-lg02.label: IDA：从漏铁到空仓库再到成品不足
c-h03-lg02.goal: connect chronic loss/need/absorption, iron transport-storage identities, tissue iron deficiency, three-stage laboratory evolution and treatment-response timeline.
c-h03-lg02.closure: given symptoms plus iron studies before or after therapy, state where the patient is on the loss → storage depletion → functional iron deficit → Hb decline / recovery sequence and why Ret can improve before Hb/storage.
c-h03-lg02.continuity_rationale: these KPs tell one disease story; separating “treatment” from the time-course would remove the reversal evidence that proves the model.

c-h03-lg03.label: 小细胞贫血：真缺铁 vs 锁铁 vs 利用失败 vs 珠蛋白问题
c-h03-lg03.goal: use SI/TS/SF/TIBC/marrow-iron directions and hepcidin to separate IDA, ACD, sideroblastic anemia and thalassemia at the level supported by Current Source.
c-h03-lg03.closure: reconstruct the iron-profile direction for the four patterns and explain the upstream failure rather than memorizing a table row.
c-h03-lg03.continuity_rationale: KP12 supplies the comparison; KP13 explains the hardest confusable pattern (ACD) causally.

c-h03-lg04.label: 巨幼：DNA成熟失败与B12安全边界
c-h03-lg04.goal: connect B12/folate-related DNA synthesis failure to nuclear–cytoplasmic asynchrony, trace the B12 absorption chain, and preserve the neurologic-risk distinction.
c-h03-lg04.closure: from macrocytosis plus gastric/pancreatic/ileal or neurologic clues, locate the likely failure in the B12/folate branch and state why folate-only correction cannot be treated as proof that B12 risk is absent.
c-h03-lg04.continuity_rationale: mechanism, absorption and B12-vs-folate discrimination form one coherent macrocytic-anemia problem. H3-SB01 remains live.

c-h03-lg05.label: 范围/形态线索与最终贫血算法
c-h03-lg05.goal: use pancytopenia and RBC morphology only as routing clues, then re-run Hb → MCV → Ret → specific evidence to avoid morphology-only diagnosis.
c-h03-lg05.closure: from an unfamiliar anemia with a smear or multi-lineage abnormality, explain what the morphology/range can and cannot prove and route to H4/H5/H7–H11 or an external owner as appropriate.
c-h03-lg05.continuity_rationale: KP17 deliberately downgrades morphology to evidence; KP18 prevents it from hijacking the core algorithm. H3-SC01 remains explicit.

hematology-h04.title: 再生障碍性贫血
hematology-h04.first_pass_focus: 把再障定位为全骨髓低增生的生产失败，并用外周+多部位骨髓证据确认严重度与治疗层级。
hematology-h04.stop_line: 不提前展开MDS/白血病；治疗只守Current Source。
hematology-h04.recall_spine: 骨髓工厂为什么整体停摆 → 外周 + 多部位骨髓 → 严重度与鉴别 → 近期危险与四层治疗角色

c-h04-lg01.label: 骨髓工厂为什么整体停摆
c-h04-lg01.goal: connect AA identity, Source-listed causes and seed–soil–immune suppression to three-line output failure and its time pattern.
c-h04-lg01.closure: from a suspected AA case, explain why the three lineages fall together, why platelets can become the earliest/most fragile output and why the model is production failure rather than peripheral consumption.
c-h04-lg01.continuity_rationale: KP01–04 are the disease’s upstream causal model; cause and mechanism should not be separated from the output they create.

c-h04-lg02.label: 外周 + 多部位骨髓：证明低增生
c-h04-lg02.goal: combine Ret/MCV/NAP/negative hepatosplenomegaly with multi-site aspirate/biopsy and marrow morphology.
c-h04-lg02.closure: choose which peripheral and marrow evidence is required to prove global low production, explain why a single active marrow site cannot overturn the whole pattern, and separate AA megakaryocytes from ITP/MDS directions.
c-h04-lg02.continuity_rationale: KP05–08 answer one evidentiary question: “how do I know the factory is globally low rather than merely seeing low cells in blood?”

c-h04-lg03.label: 严重度与鉴别：先看风险指标，再分相邻病
c-h04-lg03.goal: interpret Ret absolute count / ANC / Plt severity gates, then distinguish AA from MDS, leukemia, PNH and hypersplenism by marrow, morphology, hemolysis and organ findings.
c-h04-lg03.closure: from pancytopenia plus marrow/Ret/organ data, determine whether the pattern meets Current Source severe/very-severe direction and name the single next discriminator that redirects a confusable case.
c-h04-lg03.continuity_rationale: severity and differential are the two decisions that immediately follow proof of AA identity.

c-h04-lg04.label: 近期危险与四层治疗角色
c-h04-lg04.goal: prioritize infection/bleeding support, then distinguish HSCT, immunosuppression and hematopoietic stimulation by what layer each changes.
c-h04-lg04.closure: from age/severity/infection/donor status and current ANC/Plt risk, choose the Source-supported treatment role and state why transfusion/support, growth stimulation, immune suppression and HSCT are not substitutes for one another.
c-h04-lg04.continuity_rationale: KP11–14 form one action hierarchy after diagnosis and severity are established.

hematology-h05.title: 溶血性贫血
hematology-h05.first_pass_focus: 先证明溶血并定位破坏位置，再分内在RBC缺陷、免疫攻击与PNH等代表模型。
hematology-h05.stop_line: 不重学RBC完整生化，也不把每种遗传溶血拆成独立课程。
hematology-h05.recall_spine: 先证明溶血，再定位破坏位置 → RBC自身缺陷 → 免疫性溶血 → PNH → 六病坐标与最终溶血算法

c-h05-lg01.label: 先证明溶血，再定位破坏位置
c-h05-lg01.goal: combine destruction evidence with marrow compensation, then distinguish intravascular, extravascular and intramedullary ineffective erythropoiesis.
c-h05-lg01.closure: from anemia/Ret/bilirubin/haptoglobin/free-Hb/urine/spleen clues, prove whether hemolysis is actually present, identify the likely location and explain at least one common false jump (Ret high, jaundice, dark urine, fragments).
c-h05-lg01.continuity_rationale: these six KPs are the indispensable common diagnostic algorithm; disease names should not precede it.

c-h05-lg02.label: RBC自身缺陷：膜、酶、珠蛋白
c-h05-lg02.goal: contrast hereditary spherocytosis, G6PD deficiency and thalassemia by the failed RBC property, morphology, destruction location and confirmatory evidence.
c-h05-lg02.closure: given a family/trigger/smear/osmotic-fragility/enzyme/Hb-electrophoresis clue set, identify the failed intrinsic layer and state why a visually similar clue does not automatically prove one disease.
c-h05-lg02.continuity_rationale: these are the three major intrinsic-RBC failure types (membrane, enzyme, globin). H5-SC01 remains unresolved where Source conflicts.

c-h05-lg03.label: 免疫性溶血：温抗体 vs 冷抗体
c-h05-lg03.goal: distinguish IgG/warm/extravascular from IgM/cold/intravascular direction and connect the difference to Coombs/cold-agglutinin evidence and treatment role.
c-h05-lg03.closure: from temperature, antibody, smear and hemolysis-location clues, choose warm vs cold direction and explain why splenic removal logic differs.
c-h05-lg03.continuity_rationale: this is a complete standalone comparison problem; merging it into intrinsic RBC disorders would erase the external-immune attack distinction.

c-h05-lg04.label: PNH：从干细胞克隆到慢性血管内溶血
c-h05-lg04.goal: connect acquired stem-cell/GPI-anchor failure → CD55/59 loss → complement hemolysis → clinical thrombosis/AA/iron-loss pattern → FLAER/flow evidence → treatment roles.
c-h05-lg04.closure: reconstruct the full PNH chain from mechanism to test and treatment and explain why it is simultaneously an acquired intrinsic membrane defect, a chronic intravascular hemolysis and a marrow/clonal interface.
c-h05-lg04.continuity_rationale: mechanism, phenotype, test and treatment are one disease model and should not be learned as four separate lists.

c-h05-lg05.label: 六病坐标与最终溶血算法
c-h05-lg05.goal: compress representative hemolytic diseases onto identity/location/morphology/test/treatment axes and re-run the common algorithm before disease-specific testing.
c-h05-lg05.closure: given a novel hemolysis vignette, localize first, then select the minimal confirmatory test rather than pattern-matching directly to one remembered disease row.
c-h05-lg05.continuity_rationale: KP15 is comparison compression; KP16 enforces the correct reasoning order.

hematology-h06.title: 出血性疾病
hematology-h06.first_pass_focus: 先判哪层止血失效，再以ITP作为血小板数量/免疫破坏模型，并保留DIC最低接口。
hematology-h06.stop_line: 正常止血归A1；vWD/血友病/DIC只到Current Source边界。
hematology-h06.recall_spine: ITP → ITP当前危险与治疗层级 → 出血定位 → 扩展止血证据、纤溶/DIC与药物角色 → 最终出血病例算法

c-h06-lg01.label: ITP：破坏 + 生成障碍的证据栈
c-h06-lg01.goal: connect immune destruction/production impairment to mucocutaneous phenotype, marrow megakaryocyte maturation pattern, peripheral tests and Evans boundary.
c-h06-lg01.closure: from isolated thrombocytopenia ± anemia, distinguish ITP from marrow production failure and Evans using smear/marrow/coagulation/hemolysis evidence instead of “Plt low = ITP”.
c-h06-lg01.continuity_rationale: mechanism, phenotype, marrow and peripheral evidence jointly establish the ITP identity; Evans is the key boundary that tests whether the model generalizes.

c-h06-lg02.label: ITP当前危险与治疗层级
c-h06-lg02.goal: identify emergency bleeding scenarios, then distinguish immediate platelet support, rapid immune suppression, first-line GC and second-line TPO/anti-CD20/splenectomy roles.
c-h06-lg02.closure: from Plt, active-bleeding site and procedural/pregnancy context, state whether the case is urgent and choose the Source-supported treatment *role* without letting slow therapy substitute for immediate hemostasis.
c-h06-lg02.continuity_rationale: KP06–09 are one severity-to-action sequence. The vinca-drug naming conflict and route-of-administration Source gap remain explicit.

c-h06-lg03.label: 出血定位：形态 + Plt/BT + PT/APTT/TT
c-h06-lg03.goal: localize vascular/platelet/coagulation/fibrinolysis/combined abnormalities from bleeding pattern and first-line tests; use vWD vs hemophilia as a falsification case.
c-h06-lg03.closure: given superficial/deep/delayed bleeding plus Plt/PT/APTT/TT, identify the failed hemostatic layer and explain why normal PT/APTT does not exclude ITP and isolated APTT prolongation does not automatically equal hemophilia.
c-h06-lg03.continuity_rationale: classification, phenotype, screening tests and one high-value comparison all answer the same first diagnostic question.

c-h06-lg04.label: 扩展止血证据、纤溶/DIC与药物角色
c-h06-lg04.goal: organize vascular/coagulation/anticoagulation/fibrinolysis panels, 3P/FDP/D-dimer, the minimum Source-supported DIC model and hemostatic-drug roles without creating a complete DIC curriculum.
c-h06-lg04.closure: when first-line localization is insufficient, choose the relevant extended evidence family, state what a positive fibrinolysis marker does *not* prove, and explain why DIC can cause thrombosis and bleeding simultaneously.
c-h06-lg04.continuity_rationale: these KPs are the second-line evidence/action layer after basic localization; H6’s DIC boundary remains live.

c-h06-lg05.label: 最终出血病例算法
c-h06-lg05.goal: compress the entire Block into bleeding phenotype → CBC/Plt → first-line coagulation tests → targeted extended evidence → marrow/hemolysis/urgent action.
c-h06-lg05.closure: solve a fresh bleeding vignette while explicitly rejecting at least two common shortcuts (purpura=ITP, low Plt=ITP, APTT↑=hemophilia, normal PT/APTT=no bleeding disorder, no splenomegaly=ITP).
c-h06-lg05.continuity_rationale: this singleton is the Block’s final execution algorithm and should not be diluted inside the extended-test group.
